prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the two pigment container from mobile robot platform to workbench.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: mobile robot platform
What the inspection checks: Check whether the pigment container is on mobile robot platform.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Overhead view of a white plastic platform or fixture plate resting on a dark grey tiled surface (right side and bottom of frame). At left is a long, narrow rectangular recessed slot running vertically. The plate has numerous small drilled holes and shallow circular counterbored recesses distributed across it.

Four square white blocks are mounted on the plate, each with four corner screws. The upper-left block and lower-left block each hold a flat, pale circular disc or cap filling the central bore. The lower-middle block and the upper-right block show open, empty circular cavities with visible interior walls and shadow. At the top edge, partially cut off, are two more white square blocks with pale round features. No liquid is visible.
observations: The inspection of the mobile robot platform shows several empty circular cavities and no pigment containers are present.

args.observations: The inspection of the mobile robot platform shows several empty circular cavities and no pigment containers are present.
